title: Vuelta a España Stage 21 Neutralized as Organizers and UCI Bow to Peloton Pressure
content:
GC time gaps to be frozen 10km from the finish of explosive, technical 21st stage in Granada after teams resisted racing to the line.

Read the full article at Vuelta a España Stage 21 Neutralized as Organizers and UCI Bow to Peloton Pressure on Velo.
author: Jim Cotton
